The Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) algorithm originated as a line-drawing algorithm in computer graphics, attributed to Bresenham's contemporaries, but adapted for ray tracing and voxel traversal in the 1990s and 2000s.
It is widely used in voxel engines (e.g., Wolfenstein 3D-style raycasting) and modern volume rendering.
